BOARDS/COMMISSION/COMMITTEE REPORTS
A.
MINUTES OF PREVIOUS CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETINGS
A-1
READ AND APPROVE THE MINUTES OF THE CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY MEETING OF FEBRUARY 13, 2018
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency waive the reading and approve the Minutes of the City Council and Successor Agency meeting of February 13, 2018.
A-1 Minutes 2-13-18 CC-SA
B.
PUBLIC HEARINGS BEFORE THE CITY COUNCIL - None
C.
UNFINISHED BUSINESS OF THE CITY COUNCIL
C-1
DISCUSSION AND DIRECTION REGARDING SUPPORT OF RESTORING LOS ANGELES COUNTY SHERIFFâ€™S DEPARTMENT SWORN PERSONNEL STAFFING LEVELS
It is recommended that the City Council discuss support of restoring Los Angeles County Sheriffâ€™s Department sworn personnel staffing levels and provide direction to Staff.
C-1 ALADS Staff Report
C-1 ALADS Attachment A Resolution
C-1 ALADS Attachment B Solis Letter
D.
CITY COUNCIL AND SUCCESSOR AGENCY CONSENT CALENDAR
All matters listed under Consent Calendar are considered to be routine in nature and may be enacted by one motion approving the recommendation listed on the Agenda. One or more items may be removed from the Consent Calendar so that said item(s) may be discussed and considered individually by the City Council/Successor Agency, if a motion to remove the item(s) is approved by an affirmative vote of a majority of the members of the City Council/Successor Agency. Those specific item(s) will be considered as the first item under New Business.
D-1
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING WARRANT REGISTER NO. 1445
It is recommended that the City Council and Successor Agency adopt Resolution No. 18-5392 approving Warrant Register No. 1445.
D-1 Warrants Resolution #1445
D-2
CONSIDERATION OF THE MID YEAR BUDGET REPORT FOR FISCAL YEAR 2017-2018
It is recommended that the City Council receive and file the Fiscal Year 2017-2018 mid-year budget review.
D-2 FY 17-18 Mid Year Budget Staff Report
D-2 FY 17-18 Mid Year Budget Atttachment A Revenues
D-2 FY 17-18 Mid Year Budget Atttachment B Expenditures
D-3
CONSIDERATION OF A PARK USE AGREEMENT WITH LA PUENTE SOFTBALL INC. FOR THE YOUTH COALITION CARNIVAL
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Park Use Agreement for the Youth Coalition carnival; and (2) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreement on behalf of the City.
D-3 Youth Coalition Carnival Staff Report
D-3 Youth Coalition Carnival Attachment A Agreement
D-4
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION APPROVING A REQUEST FOR A FEE WAIVER FOR SERVANTS ARMS COMMUNITY BASED ORGANIZATION FOR A COMMUNITY BLOCK PARTY AT LA PUENTE COMMUNITY CENTER/YOUTH LEARNING ACTIVITY CENTER AND LA PUENTE PARK IN THE AMOUNT OF $4,960.00
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5393 approving a request for a fee waiver for Servants Arms Community Based Organization for a community block party in the amount of $4,960.00.
D-4 Servants Arms Fee Waiver Staff Report
D-4 Servants Arms Fee Waiver Attachment A Resolution
D-5
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING PROPOSITION 68, THE CALIFORNIA DROUGHT, WATER, PARKS, CLIMATE, COASTAL PROTECTION, AND OUTDOOR ACCESS FOR ALL ACT OF 2018
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5394 supporting Proposition 68, The California Drought, Water, Parks, Climate, Coastal Protection, and Outdoor Access for All Act of 2018.
D-5 Prop 68 Clean Water Staff Report
D-5 Prop 68 Clean Water Attachment A Resolution
D-6
CONSIDERATION OF A RESOLUTION SUPPORTING PROPOSITION 69, MOTOR VEHICLE FEES AND TAXES: RESTRICTIONS ON EXPENDITURES: APPROPRIATIONS LIMIT AND OPPOSE EFFORT TO REPEAL SB 1
It is recommended that the City Council adopt Resolution No. 18-5395 supporting Proposition 69, Motor Vehicle Fees and Taxes: Restrictions on Expenditures: Appropriations Limit and Oppose Effort to Repeal SB 1.
D-6 Prop 69 Transportation Staff Report
D-6 Prop 69 Transportation Attachment A Resolution
D-7
CONSIDERATION OF A MEMORANDUM OF UNDERSTANDING WITH THE SAN GABRIEL VALLEY COUNCIL OF GOVERNMENTS AND A CONTRACT WITH THE COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES PERTAINING TO THE DEVELOPMENT OF A PLAN TO ADDRESS HOMELESSNESS IN THE CITY OF LA PUENTE
It is recommended that the City Council: (1) approve the Memorandum of Understanding with San Gabriel Valley Council of Governments; and (2) approve the Homeless Services Contract with Los Angeles County; and (3) authorize the City Manager to execute the Agreements on behalf of the City.
D-7 Homeless Plan Staff Report
D-7 Homeless Plan Attachment A SGVCOG MOU
D-7 Homeless Plan Attachment B LA County Contract
E.
NEW BUSINESS TO BE CONSIDERED BY THE CITY COUNCIL - None

ADJOURNMENT
AVAILABILITY
Any writings or documents provided to a majority of the City Council/Successor Agency regarding any item on this agenda will be made available for public inspection during normal business hours at City Hall located at 15900 E. Main Street, the La Puente Community Center located at 501 North Glendora and the Los Angeles County Library located at 15920 E. Central. In addition, such writings and documents will be posted on the City's website at http://www.lapuente.org.
AMERICANS WITH DISABILITIES
In compliance with the Americans with Disabilities Act, if you need special assistance to participate in a City meeting or other services offered by the City, please contact the City Clerk's Office at (626) 855-1500. Notification at least 48 hours prior to the meeting or time when services are needed will assist City staff in assuring that reasonable arrangements can be made to provide accessibility to the meeting or service.
MEETING TIMES
Meetings of the City Council shall be adjourned no later than 10:30 p.m., unless a motion to supersede the 10:30 time limit to consider some or all of the remaining items listed on the Agenda, or to consider items which have been added to the Agenda in accordance with the provisions of the Ralph M. Brown Act, Government Code Section 54950, et seq., is approved by a majority of the members of the City Council. (Ordinance No. 95-727).
